# Generated by the ZIN content builder (the journey-slice mechanic modules). Do not edit; change the module data in tools/content/data/mech_journey_*.json.
# Effects of Eindil's journey. Arguments are temporary variables zin_arg_<name> set just before the call (E1).
zin_eindil_add_renown = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_renown = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_eindil_renown min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
}
zin_eindil_add_delay = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_delay = zin_arg_value }
	set_temp_variable = { eind_delay_max = constant:zin_eindil.delay_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_eindil_delay min = 0 max = eind_delay_max }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
}
zin_eindil_regard_opinion = {
	# This country's opinion of the Host (once it exists) follows its regard: remembered at 25 and above, wronged at -25 and below.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage > 8 } zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			save_event_target_as = zin_eindil_host_target
		}
		if = {
			limit = { zin_eindil_friend = yes }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:zin_eindil_host_target modifier = zin_eindil_remembered }
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:zin_eindil_host_target modifier = zin_eindil_wronged }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { zin_eindil_resents = yes }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:zin_eindil_host_target modifier = zin_eindil_wronged }
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:zin_eindil_host_target modifier = zin_eindil_remembered }
		}
		else = {
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:zin_eindil_host_target modifier = zin_eindil_remembered }
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:zin_eindil_host_target modifier = zin_eindil_wronged }
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_add_regard = {
	# Adds zin_arg_value to Eindil's regard for this country, clamps -100 to 100, and settles the opinion modifiers once the Host exists.
	add_to_variable = { zin_eindil_regard = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_eindil_regard min = -100 max = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
	zin_eindil_regard_opinion = yes
}
zin_eindil_apply_opinions = {
	# The Host exists or the crown is offered: every friend and every resentful realm takes its opinion modifier toward the Host or the crowned realm.
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { zin_eindil_friend = yes zin_eindil_resents = yes } }
		zin_eindil_regard_opinion = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_setup = {
	# Journey setup: the start values, the waking floor by rule and story pace, and the 0 to 20 day jitter of stage 1.
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_renown = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_delay = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hold_until = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_eindil_waking option = EARLY } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 1.25 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wake_age = 138 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.1 } check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.9 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wake_age = 69 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wake_age = 92 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_eindil_waking option = LATE } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 1.25 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wake_age = 1601 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.1 } check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.9 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wake_age = 800 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wake_age = 1067 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 1.25 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wake_age = 506 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.1 } check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.9 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wake_age = 253 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wake_age = 337 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = eind_jitter min = 0 max = 21 integer = yes }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wake_age = eind_jitter }
}
zin_eindil_update_clock = {
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_clock = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_eindil_clock = global.zin_eindil_day0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_age = global.zin_eindil_clock }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_eindil_age = global.zin_eindil_delay }
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age = global.zin_eindil_clock }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age = global.zin_eindil_since }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_named_since > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_named_age = global.zin_eindil_clock }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_eindil_named_age = global.zin_eindil_named_since }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_done_since > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_age = global.zin_eindil_clock }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_age = global.zin_eindil_hall_done_since }
	}
}
zin_eindil_arm_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			country_event = { id = zin_eindil.2 days = 7 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { GAA = { exists = yes } }
		GAA = {
			country_event = { id = zin_eindil.2 days = 7 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { MAG = { exists = yes } }
		MAG = {
			country_event = { id = zin_eindil.2 days = 7 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { SEL = { exists = yes } }
		SEL = {
			country_event = { id = zin_eindil.2 days = 7 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		AEN = {
			country_event = { id = zin_eindil.2 days = 7 }
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_pulse = {
	zin_eindil_update_clock = yes
	zin_eindil_flag_watch = yes
	zin_eindil_guest_rules = yes
	zin_eindil_stage_runner = yes
	zin_eindil_check_advance = yes
}
zin_eindil_flag_watch = {
	# Flags that events set and this system must notice: the war-king (layouts, stage 3), the naming (the stage-6 clock), the hall (the travel clock), the restoration (portrait).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_war_king NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_war_king_seen } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_war_king_seen
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_3_done
		zin_eindil_refresh_layouts = yes
		zin_eindil_refresh_portrait = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_named check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_named_since = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_named_since = global.zin_eindil_clock }
		zin_eindil_refresh_portrait = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 7 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_done_since = 0 } OR = { has_global_flag = zin_glo_with_eindil has_global_flag = zin_glo_dimmed } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_done_since = global.zin_eindil_clock }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_restored NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_restored_seen } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_restored_seen
		zin_eindil_refresh_portrait = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_guest_rules = {
	# A host that starts an offensive war loses its guest within a pulse: he leaves, the delay grows by 30 days and the host's regard falls.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage > 0 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage < 9 } zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { zin_eindil_host_offends = yes }
				zin_eindil_guest_offence = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_guest_offence = {
	# The scope is the host that took up an offensive war.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 30 }
	zin_eindil_add_delay = yes
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -20 }
	zin_eindil_add_regard = yes
	zin_eindil_clear_host = yes
}
zin_eindil_hold_guest = {
	# zin_arg_days: the host keeps the guest this long (a bound or detained guest); the stages cannot start before the hold is over.
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hold_until = global.zin_eindil_clock }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hold_until = zin_arg_days }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_days = 0 }
}
zin_eindil_check_advance = {
	# The highest stage that is ready starts (skips jump over a stage whose antagonist is gone).
	if = {

		zin_eindil_advance_stage = yes

		limit = { zin_eindil_ready_10 = yes }

		limit = { zin_eindil_ready_9 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = 9 }
		zin_eindil_advance_stage = yes

	else_if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_ready_8 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = 8 }
		zin_eindil_advance_stage = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_ready_7 = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = 7 }
		zin_eindil_advance_stage = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_ready_6 = yes }

	else_if = {

zin_eindil_release_character = {
	# The scope is a host that lets the guest go.
	retire_character = zin_eindil
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 1 } }
		clr_country_flag = zin_potent_magic
	}
	if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_eindil_stranger_among_us } remove_ideas = zin_eindil_stranger_among_us }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_eindil_restless_guest } remove_ideas = zin_eindil_restless_guest }
}
zin_eindil_clear_host = {
	# He is at sea, or between hosts: the host (if any) lets him go and the host variable is cleared.
	if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			zin_eindil_release_character = yes
		}
	}
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_host
}
zin_eindil_set_host = {
	# The scope becomes his host. zin_arg_role: 0 or 1 corps commander, 2 field marshal, 3 advisor "Guest of Lorien", 4 no role.
	if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { tag = PREV } }
				zin_eindil_release_character = yes
			}
			else = {
				retire_character = zin_eindil
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_host = THIS }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = zin_eindil } } zin_eindil = { set_nationality = PREV } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_in_play_eindil } } set_global_flag = zin_in_play_eindil }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_role = 2 } }
		add_field_marshal_role = { character = zin_eindil skill = 5 attack_skill = 5 defense_skill = 4 planning_skill = 4 logistics_skill = 3 traits = { zin_eindil_man_from_the_ice } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_role = 3 } }
		add_advisor_role = { character = zin_eindil advisor = { slot = political_advisor cost = 0 idea_token = zin_eindil_guest_of_lorien traits = { zin_eindil_guest_trait } } activate = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_role = 4 } }
	}
	else = {
		add_corps_commander_role = { character = zin_eindil skill = 4 attack_skill = 4 defense_skill = 4 planning_skill = 3 logistics_skill = 3 traits = { zin_eindil_man_from_the_ice } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { zin_arg_role = 3 } } NOT = { check_variable = { zin_arg_role = 4 } } }
		zin_eindil = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_war_king }
				add_unit_leader_trait = zin_eindil_war_king
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_named }
				add_unit_leader_trait = zin_eindil_heir_of_aen
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 1 } }
				add_unit_leader_trait = zin_eindil_bearer_of_glo
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_restored }
				add_unit_leader_trait = zin_eindil_blessed_of_the_new_gods
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_recovered has_global_flag = zin_eindil_cast_down }
				add_unit_leader_trait = zin_eindil_maimed_unbroken
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = zin_potent_magic
	}
	zin_glo_follow_bearer = yes
	zin_eindil_refresh_portrait = yes
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_role = 0 }
}
zin_eindil_refresh_portrait = {
	# The seven portrait states E1 to E7 follow the story flags; until the art pipeline draws them each is the generic man (data: portraits).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crowned }
		set_portraits = { character = zin_eindil civilian = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } army = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_recovered has_global_flag = zin_eindil_cast_down }
		set_portraits = { character = zin_eindil civilian = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } army = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_restored }
		set_portraits = { character = zin_eindil civilian = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } army = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 1 } }
		set_portraits = { character = zin_eindil civilian = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } army = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_named }
		set_portraits = { character = zin_eindil civilian = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } army = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_war_king }
		set_portraits = { character = zin_eindil civilian = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } army = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } }
	}
	else = {
		set_portraits = { character = zin_eindil civilian = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } army = { large = GFX_zin_portrait_men_male_1 } }
	}
}
zin_eindil_name_him = {
	# Lorien's naming (journey event .52 calls this; the pulse calls it when the Gala court has stalled for 400 days).
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_named } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_named
		set_character_name = { character = zin_eindil name = zin_eindil_name_named }
		zin_eindil = {
			add_unit_leader_trait = zin_eindil_heir_of_aen
		}
		zin_eindil_refresh_portrait = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_refresh_layouts = {
	# E4: story setters that change what the trees show refresh the layouts of the countries whose trees read them.
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = zin_region_cold_lands has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands has_country_flag = zin_region_islands_of_the_south has_country_flag = zin_region_tritons_islands } }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_bearer_effects = {
	# Glo is with him (journey event .73, or the seal opens: zin_glo.80): the trait, the renown, the portrait, and word to Gala.
	zin_eindil = {
		add_unit_leader_trait = zin_eindil_bearer_of_glo
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
	zin_eindil_add_renown = yes
	zin_eindil_refresh_portrait = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_gala_host }
		var:global.zin_eindil_gala_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_eindil.163 days = 90 }
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_fire_bearer_leaves = {
	# Glo passes to Eindil in the hall: The Bearer Leaves Yeldenne goes to his host, or at sea to Gala as witness (journey event .73).
	if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.73 days = 3 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_gala_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_gala_host = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.73 days = 3 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_lose_heir = {
	# The heir is out of the story (divergence only): the flag and the news (journey event .140, which fires the endings' league event).
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_lost } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_lost
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_eindil.140 }
		}
		zin_ending_heir_lost = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_wound = {
	# zin_arg_days (default 120): the grievously wounded trait for that many days.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_days = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_days = 120 }
	}
	zin_eindil = {
		add_timed_unit_leader_trait = { trait = zin_eindil_grievously_wounded days = zin_arg_days }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_days = 0 }
}
zin_eindil_enter_1 = {
	set_global_flag = zin_eindil_awake
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_ice_host
	random_state = {
		limit = { zin_is_site_eindil_ice = yes }
		owner = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ice_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_ice_host } }
		random_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_cold_lands exists = yes NOT = { original_tag = CLD } NOT = { original_tag = MLK } NOT = { zin_glo_hall_owner = yes } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ice_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	zin_eindil_refresh_layouts = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_ice_host }
		var:global.zin_eindil_ice_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_eindil.10 }
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_enter_2 = {

		limit = { zin_is_site_winter_ford = yes }
		owner = {

		}
	}
	if = {

				set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ford_host = THIS }

	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_trial_host
	572 = {
		owner = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_trial_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {

		var:global.zin_eindil_bridge_host = {

				limit = { exists = yes }

			}

	}
}
zin_eindil_form_confederation = {
	# The Grey Ford Confederation (proposed): the western country other than Gunwaith and Girdon with the highest regard (ties to the most states) leads; members have regard 0 or more.
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_confed_member }
		clr_country_flag = zin_eindil_confed_member
	}
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_confed_leader
	set_temp_variable = { eind_best = -999999 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands exists = yes NOT = { original_tag = GNW } NOT = { original_tag = GIR } has_capitulated = no }
		set_temp_variable = { eind_score = zin_eindil_regard }
		multiply_temp_variable = { eind_score = 1000 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { eind_score = num_owned_states }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { eind_score > eind_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { eind_best = eind_score }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands exists = yes NOT = { original_tag = GNW } NOT = { original_tag = GIR } has_capitulated = no }
		set_temp_variable = { eind_score = zin_eindil_regard }
		multiply_temp_variable = { eind_score = 1000 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { eind_score = num_owned_states }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { eind_score = eind_best } NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_confed_leader } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_confed_leader = THIS }
			set_country_flag = zin_eindil_confed_member
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands exists = yes NOT = { original_tag = GNW } NOT = { original_tag = GIR } has_capitulated = no check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > -1 } }
		set_country_flag = zin_eindil_confed_member
	}
}
zin_eindil_enter_3 = {
	# The war-king's road: the confederation forms; its leader gets the offer through the pulse when the feud breaks (or on the fallback date).
	zin_eindil_clear_host = yes
	zin_eindil_form_confederation = yes
	clr_global_flag = zin_eindil_s3_fired
}
zin_eindil_enter_4 = {
	# The storm: he sails from the leader's coast and is at sea; the wreck, reef and shrine hosts are chosen.
	zin_eindil_clear_host = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_idea = zin_eindil_war_kings_banner }
		remove_ideas = zin_eindil_war_kings_banner
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_confed_member }
		clr_country_flag = zin_eindil_confed_member
	}
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_departure_host
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_confed_leader }
		var:global.zin_eindil_confed_leader = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_departure_host = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_departure_host } }
		random_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands exists = yes any_owned_state = { is_coastal = yes } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_departure_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_wreck_host
	if = {
		limit = { HWN = { exists = yes } }
		HWN = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wreck_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_wreck_host } }
		random_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_islands_of_the_south exists = yes }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_wreck_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_reef_host
	random_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes OR = { original_tag = NAR original_tag = VER } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_reef_host = THIS }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_reef_host } has_variable = global.zin_eindil_wreck_host }
		var:global.zin_eindil_wreck_host = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_reef_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_shrine_host
	random_state = {
		limit = { zin_is_site_south_shrine = yes }
		owner = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_shrine_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_shrine_host } }
		if = {
			limit = { ENH = { exists = yes } }
			ENH = {
				set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_shrine_host = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_departure_host }
		var:global.zin_eindil_departure_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_eindil.40 }
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_pick_gala_host = {
	# The Gala Elves; else the country that employs Lorien; else the owner of Gala's capital.
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_gala_host

		limit = { GAA = { exists = yes } }
		GAA = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_gala_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_gala_host } }
		random_country = {
			limit = { has_character = zin_lorien exists = yes }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_gala_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_gala_host } }
		786 = {
			owner = {
				set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_gala_host = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_eindil_pick_stage8_host = {
	# Selen (Alleria); if Selen is gone, capitulated or ruled by the Deliverer, the Middle Lands country with the highest regard that is not an Aenor realm; then the Magical Forest.
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_stage8_host
	if = {
		limit = { SEL = { exists = yes has_capitulated = no NOT = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes } } }
		SEL = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage8_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_stage8_host } }
		set_temp_variable = { eind_best = -999999 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_middle_lands exists = yes has_capitulated = no NOT = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes } NOT = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { eind_score = zin_eindil_regard }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { eind_score > eind_best } }
				set_temp_variable = { eind_best = eind_score }
			}
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_middle_lands exists = yes has_capitulated = no NOT = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes } NOT = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes } check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard = eind_best } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage8_host = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_stage8_host } }
		if = {
			limit = { MAG = { exists = yes } }
			MAG = {
				set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage8_host = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_eindil_pick_battlefield = {
	# The battlefield of the return: an Aenor-cored state held by Zol, else by Volgan, else any Aenor-cored state held by an enemy (stored as a state variable for the first wave of Glo).
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_battlefield
	random_state = {
		limit = { is_core_of = AEN controller = { OR = { original_tag = ZOL is_subject_of = ZOL } } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battlefield = THIS }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_battlefield } }
		random_state = {
			limit = { is_core_of = AEN controller = { OR = { original_tag = PUV is_subject_of = PUV } } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battlefield = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_battlefield } }
		random_state = {
			limit = { is_core_of = AEN NOT = { is_controlled_by = OWNER } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battlefield = THIS }
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_enter_9 = {
	# The return: the flag, the battlefield, the world is told. The Host is raised by journey event .92 (or by the pulse after 14 days).
	set_global_flag = zin_eindil_returned
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_quiet_return
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle_next = 0 }
	zin_eindil_pick_battlefield = yes
	zin_eindil_refresh_layouts = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		news_event = { id = zin_eindil.90 }
	}
}
zin_eindil_cliff_effects = {
	# Idempotent: Eindil's role is suspended and the Host carries the rumour spirit until he recovers (journey event .110 may call it first).
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_cliff_done } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_cliff_done
		if = {
			limit = { zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				add_ideas = zin_eindil_king_is_dead
				if = { limit = { AND = { has_character = zin_eindil has_global_flag = zin_in_play_eindil } } retire_character = zin_eindil }
			}
		}
	}
}

	# Alleria's scouts bring him out of the ravine (journey event .113, or the pulse after 400 days): the flag, the role and the maimed trait.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_recovered } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_recovered
		if = {
			limit = { zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_eindil_king_is_dead } remove_ideas = zin_eindil_king_is_dead }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_role = 2 }
				zin_eindil_set_host = yes
			}
		}
		zin_eindil_refresh_portrait = yes
	}
}

zin_eindil_advance_stage = {
	# Starts the stage in zin_arg_to (default: the next one): the stage counter, its clock, and the stage's own entry.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_to = 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = zin_arg_to }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_since = global.zin_eindil_clock }
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hold_until = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 1 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_1 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 2 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_2 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 3 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_3 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 4 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_4 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 5 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_5 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 6 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_6 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 7 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_7 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 8 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_8 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 9 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_9 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 10 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_10 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 11 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_11 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 12 } }
		zin_eindil_enter_12 = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_king_without_a_house = {
	# End of stage 2: the news reaches every western court once his deeds are known (renown 20), else only the hosts of the road.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_renown > 19 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands exists = yes }
			country_event = { id = zin_eindil.23 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_bridge_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_bridge_host = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.23 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_ford_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_ford_host = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.23 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_trial_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_trial_host = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.23 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_stage3_runner = {
	# Stage 3: A Crown Offered reaches the leader when the feud breaks, or on the fallback date; the stage is done when the war-king lays the crown down.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_s3_fired } has_variable = global.zin_eindil_confed_leader }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_grey_ford_war }
			set_global_flag = zin_eindil_s3_fired
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_confed_leader }
				var:global.zin_eindil_confed_leader = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						country_event = { id = zin_eindil.30 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_permanent zin_eindil_date_1750_09 = yes } }
			set_global_flag = zin_eindil_s3_fired
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_confed_leader }
				var:global.zin_eindil_confed_leader = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						country_event = { id = zin_eindil.31 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 270 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_3_done } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_3_done
	}
}
zin_eindil_compute_ambush = {
	# N9: 5 + ports betrayed + 1 if hunted + 1 each for the Worshipdom's ships, hunters and Whispers 4 - 1 if elven crew - 1 per guide flag - 1 if the Deliverer sent others. Stored in global.zin_eindil_ambush_strength.
	set_temp_variable = { eind_str = constant:zin_eindil.ambush_base }
	add_to_temp_variable = { eind_str = global.zin_eindil_ports_betrayed }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_hunted }
		add_to_temp_variable = { eind_str = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_ships_ready } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { eind_str = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_hunters } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { eind_str = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_afrit_seat_whispers > 3 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { eind_str = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_elven_crew }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { eind_str = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_landing_guides }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { eind_str = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_yeldenne_beacon }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { eind_str = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_yeldenne_coast_watch }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { eind_str = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_yeldenne_guides }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { eind_str = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_sent_others }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { eind_str = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_strength = eind_str }
	log = "ZIN journey: ambush strength [?global.zin_eindil_ambush_strength]"
}
zin_eindil_ambush_resolved = {
	# Called by journey event .71 with zin_arg_value = the strength it computed (or by the pulse with its own computation): Afrit reached the hall first (strength 2 or more) or the heir did.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_ambush_done } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_ambush_done
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_strength = zin_arg_value }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_strength > 1 } has_global_flag = zin_afrit_at_yeldenne NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_sent_others } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_let_land } zin_horos_alive = yes }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_a_at = global.zin_eindil_clock }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_a_at = 14 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_b_at = global.zin_eindil_clock }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_b_at = 7 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
}
zin_eindil_stage7_runner = {
	# 21 days after landfall the ambush is settled (journey event .71 calls zin_eindil_ambush_resolved; at 28 days the pulse settles it by the same formula); then the hall.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 27 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_ambush_done } }
		zin_eindil_compute_ambush = yes
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = global.zin_eindil_ambush_strength }
		zin_eindil_ambush_resolved = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_a_at > 0 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_clock > global.zin_eindil_hall_a_at } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_a_at = 0 }
		zin_glo_hall_historical = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_b_at > 0 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_clock > global.zin_eindil_hall_b_at } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hall_b_at = 0 }
		zin_glo_heir_arrives = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_start_hunt = {
	# Denounce and hunt (journey event .82) and the Worshipdom's Hunt him (zin_afrit.40) call this: one hunt, the rolls do not stack.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_hunt_active } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_hunt_active
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hunt_clock = global.zin_eindil_clock }
	}
}
zin_eindil_to_the_forest = {
	# Eindil goes to the elven woods (once): The Bearer in the Forest reaches the Magical Forest.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_s8_forest_fired } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_s8_forest_fired
		MAG = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_eindil.86 }
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_make_dragon_pact = {
	# The dragon is entrusted to the bearer (journey event .88 A, or Varner's forced pact on 1757.7.1): the flag, the roost bond, and The Dragon Chooses for the Keeper.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_dragon_pact } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_dragon_pact
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
		zin_elves_add_roost_bond = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_world_is_dragon_keeper = yes }
			country_event = { id = zin_eindil.169 days = 7 }
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_stage8_runner = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_s8_forest_fired } }
		zin_eindil_to_the_forest = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_hunt_active check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hunt_clock > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { eind_hunt_next = global.zin_eindil_hunt_clock }
		add_to_temp_variable = { eind_hunt_next = 90 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_clock > eind_hunt_next } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_hunt_clock = global.zin_eindil_clock }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_crown_shelters } } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
					var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
						if = {
							limit = { exists = yes }
							country_event = { id = zin_eindil.84 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_date_1757_07 = yes NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_dragon_pact } }
		zin_eindil_make_dragon_pact = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_pick_host_candidate = {
	# The sworn country that exists (Selen first); unset when there is none.
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_host_candidate
	if = {
		limit = { SEL = { exists = yes has_country_flag = zin_eindil_sworn has_capitulated = no } }
		SEL = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_host_candidate = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host_candidate } }
		random_country = {
			limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = zin_eindil_sworn has_capitulated = no }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_host_candidate = THIS }
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_found_coalition = {
	# The scope is the Host: it leads the Lost Cause league (founded here unless the Lost Cause was given to it), and every country that said yes before is added.
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_faction = no }
		create_faction_from_template = { template = zin_faction_lost_cause name = ZIN_FACTION_LOST_CAUSE }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_faction_leader = no }
		set_faction_leader = yes
	}
	set_global_flag = zin_eindil_coalition_founded
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_coalition_member is_in_faction = no }
		PREV = {
			add_to_faction = PREV
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_grant_dragon = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_dragon_pact }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_amount = 1 }
		zin_war_grant_dragons = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_raise_host = {
	# zin_arg_choice: 1 raise the Host (cosmetic name, claims), 2 stand beside him (own name), 0 automatic. The scope is the sworn country; with none, a dynamic Host is made.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_host_raised } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_host_raised
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_host_raised_at = global.zin_eindil_clock }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_choice = 0 } NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_sworn } }
			zin_eindil_create_dynamic_host = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_choice = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_choice = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_subject = yes }
				overlord = {
					end_puppet = PREV
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_role = 2 }
			zin_eindil_set_host = yes
			add_ideas = zin_eindil_host_of_the_heir
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_choice = 1 } }
				set_cosmetic_tag = zin_host_of_eindil
				every_state = {
					limit = { is_core_of = AEN NOT = { is_owned_by = PREV } owner = { OR = { original_tag = PUV original_tag = ZOL is_subject_of = PUV is_subject_of = ZOL zin_afrit_rules_here = yes } } }
					add_claim_by = PREV
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_eindil_coalition_member
			zin_eindil_grant_dragon = yes
			zin_eindil_apply_opinions = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_choice = 0 }
}
zin_eindil_create_dynamic_host = {
	# No sworn country: a dynamic country of Aenor's original tag is raised as the Host (renown / 10 hosts of survivors, at least 3), or a court in exile in the Magical Forest.
	create_dynamic_country = { original_tag = AEN set_global_flag = zin_eindil_host_dynamic set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_dynamic_host = THIS } zin_eindil_stock_dynamic_host = yes }
}
zin_eindil_stock_dynamic_host = {
	# The scope is the new Host: a state, a leader, survivors, a coalition. Without a state it is a court in exile in the Magical Forest.
	set_cosmetic_tag = zin_host_of_eindil
	set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic last_election = "1746.3.1" election_frequency = 48 elections_allowed = no }
	set_popularities = { democratic = 80 neutrality = 15 fascism = 5 communism = 0 }
	random_state = {
		limit = { is_core_of = AEN owner = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes NOT = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes } OR = { has_war_with = PUV has_war_with = ZOL } } }
		transfer_state_to = PREV
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { num_owned_states = 0 } }
		become_exiled_in = { target = MAG legitimacy = 100 }
	}
	add_ideas = zin_eindil_host_of_the_heir
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_role = 2 }
	zin_eindil_set_host = yes
	add_country_leader_role = { character = zin_eindil promote_leader = yes country_leader = { ideology = zin_light_wardens expire = "2000.1.1.1" traits = { zin_eindil_king_without_a_house } } }
	division_template = { name = "Host of the Heir" regiments = { zin_men_infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 } zin_men_infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 } zin_men_infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 } zin_men_infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 } zin_men_infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 } zin_men_archers = { x = 1 y = 2 } } }
	set_temp_variable = { eind_divs = global.zin_eindil_renown }
	divide_temp_variable = { eind_divs = constant:zin_eindil.renown_per_division }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { eind_divs < 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { eind_divs = 3 }
	}
	round_temp_variable = eind_divs
	for_loop_effect = {
		end = eind_divs
		create_unit = { division = "name = \"Survivors of the Heir\" division_template = \"Host of the Heir\" start_experience_factor = 0.3" owner = THIS }
	}
	set_country_flag = zin_eindil_coalition_member
	zin_eindil_grant_dragon = yes
	zin_eindil_apply_opinions = yes
}
zin_eindil_join_coalition = {
	# The scope joins the Host's league and rides with it; the Host's AI befriends it.
	set_country_flag = zin_eindil_coalition_member
	if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
				add_to_faction = PREV
			}
			meta_effect = { text = { add_ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = "[eind_tag]" value = 100 } } eind_tag = "[PREV.GetTag]" }
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_aid_host = {
	# The scope sends equipment and levies to the Host. zin_arg_type: 0 zin_arms_equipment (default), 1 giant gear, 2 yeti gear, 3 troll gear, 4 elven arms; zin_arg_equipment, zin_arg_manpower.
	if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_type = 0 } }
			send_equipment = { equipment = zin_arms_equipment amount = zin_arg_equipment target = var:global.zin_eindil_host }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_type = 1 } }
			send_equipment = { equipment = zin_giant_gear_equipment amount = zin_arg_equipment target = var:global.zin_eindil_host }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_type = 2 } }
			send_equipment = { equipment = zin_yeti_gear_equipment amount = zin_arg_equipment target = var:global.zin_eindil_host }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_type = 3 } }
			send_equipment = { equipment = zin_troll_gear_equipment amount = zin_arg_equipment target = var:global.zin_eindil_host }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_type = 4 } }
			send_equipment = { equipment = zin_elven_arms_equipment amount = zin_arg_equipment target = var:global.zin_eindil_host }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_manpower > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { eind_levies = zin_arg_manpower }
			add_manpower = zin_arg_manpower
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				add_manpower = eind_levies
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_equipment = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_manpower = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_type = 0 }
}
zin_eindil_hail_the_king = {
	# Battle 5, Hailed as King (journey event .102): the Host and every coalition member.
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_eindil.102 }
			}
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_coalition_member NOT = { zin_eindil_is_host = yes } }
		country_event = { id = zin_eindil.102 }
	}
}
zin_eindil_battles = {
	# The battles of the return, each on its condition under the free rule and on its date under the historical rule (journey spec, stage 9).
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_quiet_return check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 60 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_9_done
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_lost }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_9_done
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle < 3 } OR = { NOT = { PUV = { exists = yes } } has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle < 3 } OR = { zin_eindil_date_1758_03 = yes check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 365 } } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 3 }
			set_global_flag = zin_eindil_south_unfought
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 0 } zin_eindil_has_host = yes OR = { AND = { zin_eindil_historical = yes zin_eindil_date_1757_06 = yes } AND = { zin_eindil_historical = no any_state = { zin_eindil_army_near = yes controller = { OR = { original_tag = PUV is_subject_of = PUV } } } } } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle_next = global.zin_eindil_clock }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle_next = 30 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
				var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						country_event = { id = zin_eindil.96 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 1 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_clock > global.zin_eindil_battle_next } OR = { zin_eindil_historical = no zin_eindil_date_1757_07 = yes } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 2 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle_next = global.zin_eindil_clock }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle_next = 30 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
					var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
						if = {
							limit = { exists = yes }
							country_event = { id = zin_eindil.98 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				every_country = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					news_event = { id = zin_eindil.99 }
				}
				set_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_9_done
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 2 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_clock > global.zin_eindil_battle_next } OR = { AND = { zin_eindil_historical = yes zin_eindil_date_1757_08 = yes } AND = { zin_eindil_historical = no any_state = { zin_eindil_army_near = yes controller = { OR = { original_tag = PUV is_subject_of = PUV } } } } } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 3 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
				var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						country_event = { id = zin_eindil.100 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 3 } OR = { has_global_flag = zin_kusven_forth has_global_flag = zin_horos_sword_broken } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 3 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 4 } } OR = { has_global_flag = zin_kusven_withdrawn AND = { zin_eindil_date_1757_12 = yes NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_kusven_forth } } zin_eindil_date_1758_09 = yes } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_battle = 5 }
			set_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_9_done
			zin_eindil_hail_the_king = yes
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_stage9_runner = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_host_raised } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 9 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 13 } }
		zin_eindil_pick_host_candidate = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host_candidate }
			var:global.zin_eindil_host_candidate = {
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_choice = 1 }
				zin_eindil_raise_host = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			zin_eindil_create_dynamic_host = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_host_raised NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_coalition_founded } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_host_raised_at > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { eind_coalition_at = global.zin_eindil_host_raised_at }
		add_to_temp_variable = { eind_coalition_at = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_clock > eind_coalition_at } zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				zin_eindil_found_coalition = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 9 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_9_done } }
		zin_eindil_battles = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 9 } has_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_9_done NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_cast_down } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_returned } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_recovered } zin_eindil_floor_reached = yes }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_recovered
	}
}
zin_eindil_palace_reset = {
	# After a failed attempt the flags of the chain are cleared (journey event .127).
	clr_global_flag = zin_palace_passages
	clr_global_flag = zin_palace_rebels
}
zin_eindil_found_parim_realm = {
	# No Aenor realm exists but the Host or a coalition member owns Parim: a new Aenor realm is created there and takes every Aenor-cored state the coalition owns.
	if = {
		limit = { any_state = { zin_is_site_parim = yes owner = { zin_eindil_coalition_ally = yes } } }
		create_dynamic_country = { original_tag = AEN set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm = THIS } set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic last_election = "1746.3.1" election_frequency = 48 elections_allowed = no } }
		var:global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm = {
			every_state = {
				limit = { zin_is_site_parim = yes }
				transfer_state_to = PREV
			}
			every_state = {
				limit = { is_core_of = AEN owner = { zin_eindil_coalition_ally = yes } }
				transfer_state_to = PREV
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_go_to_parim = {
	# Stage 12: find the crowning realm (never moves Eindil) and fire The Crown Is Offered; if Parim is held by an enemy, The Crown Withheld (the pulse retries every 30 days).
	clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm
	if = {
		limit = { zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
				set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm } }
		random_country = {
			limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes exists = yes NOT = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes } NOT = { zin_eindil_war_with_host = yes } NOT = { zin_eindil_is_host = yes } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm } NOT = { any_country = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes exists = yes } } }
		zin_eindil_found_parim_realm = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_crown_offered
		var:global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_eindil.130 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { zin_eindil_has_host = yes }
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes } }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.130 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.132 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_eindil_after_coronation = {
	# The end state once zin_eindil_crowned is set (Aenor's zin_aenor.400): the leader trait, the dynamic Host comes home, Selen drops the cosmetic name, the first friends.
	zin_eindil = {
		add_country_leader_trait = zin_eindil_rightful_king
	}
	zin_eindil_refresh_portrait = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_host_dynamic has_variable = global.zin_eindil_dynamic_host }
		var:global.zin_eindil_dynamic_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_eindil.131 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_annex_at = global.zin_eindil_clock }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_annex_at = 14 }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_idea = zin_eindil_host_of_the_heir NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_dynamic_host } }
		remove_ideas = zin_eindil_host_of_the_heir
		if = { limit = { has_cosmetic_tag = zin_host_of_eindil } drop_cosmetic_tag = yes }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 49 } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_eindil_first_friends days = 1825 }
	}
	zin_eindil_apply_opinions = yes
}
zin_eindil_annex_dynamic_host = {
	# 14 days after the coronation the dynamic Host is annexed by the crowned realm (its player has been offered the switch by event .131).
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_dynamic_host has_variable = global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm }
		var:global.zin_eindil_crowning_realm = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				annex_country = { target = var:global.zin_eindil_dynamic_host }
			}
		}
		clear_variable = global.zin_eindil_dynamic_host
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_annex_at = 0 }
}
zin_eindil_stage_runner = {
	# What a stage does with its days: reminders, the ports of call, the hall, the hunt, the battles, the coronation.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 1 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 149 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_s1_road_fired } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_s1_road_fired
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_ice_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_ice_host = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.12 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 2 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 109 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_s2_end_fired } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_s2_end_fired
		zin_eindil_king_without_a_house = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 3 } }
		zin_eindil_stage3_runner = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 4 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 250 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_s4_end_fired } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_s4_end_fired
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_wreck_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_wreck_host = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.45 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 5 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 400 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_named } }
		zin_eindil_name_him = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_eindil.170 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 6 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 39 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_s6_port2 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_s6_port2
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_port_2 }
			var:global.zin_eindil_port_2 = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.61 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 6 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 79 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_s6_port3 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_s6_port3
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_port_3 }
			var:global.zin_eindil_port_3 = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.61 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 7 } }
		zin_eindil_stage7_runner = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 8 } }
		zin_eindil_stage8_runner = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage > 8 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage < 10 } }
		zin_eindil_stage9_runner = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 10 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage_age > 400 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_recovered } }
		zin_eindil_recover = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage = 12 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crowned } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_clock > global.zin_eindil_crown_next } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crown_offered } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_crown_next = global.zin_eindil_clock }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_eindil_crown_next = 30 }
		zin_eindil_go_to_parim = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crowned NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_aftermath_done } }
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_aftermath_done
		zin_eindil_after_coronation = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_annex_at > 0 } check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_clock > global.zin_eindil_annex_at } }
		zin_eindil_annex_dynamic_host = yes
	}
}
zin_eindil_host_lost = {
	# The host was annexed or capitulated: Eindil moves to the best friend of the lost host, never to the annexer; +30 days of delay.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 30 }
	zin_eindil_add_delay = yes
	set_temp_variable = { eind_best = -999999 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes has_capitulated = no NOT = { zin_eindil_is_host = yes } NOT = { tag = ROOT } NOT = { tag = FROM } }
		set_temp_variable = { eind_score = zin_eindil_regard }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { eind_score > eind_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { eind_best = eind_score }
		}
	}
	zin_eindil_clear_host = yes
	random_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes has_capitulated = no NOT = { tag = ROOT } NOT = { tag = FROM } check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard = eind_best } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_stage > 8 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_role = 2 }
		}
		zin_eindil_set_host = yes
	}
}
